paraphrases.title: Unsanitized join: ../secret escapes outside the base directory
paraphrases.body: filePath joins the user name without checks, so ../secret resolves outside the base directory and exposes other files. Reject .. segments. Proof: ../secret lands outside the base on this head.

paraphrases.title: No traversal guard, ../secret reads outside the base
paraphrases.body: Passing ../secret as the name yields a path outside the intended base because join does not normalize against escapes. Proof: ../secret is outside the base here.
